title: netcode_generate_connect_token: server-address bounds are assert-only, so release builds write past a stack array

nodes.body:
Fixed and released in [netcode 1.4.3](https://github.com/mas-bandwidth/netcode/releases/tag/v1.4.3).

`netcode_generate_connect_token` now returns `NETCODE_ERROR` for an out-of-range `num_server_addresses` instead of relying on asserts that `-DNDEBUG` removes — matching what every other public entry point in the file already did.

Regression test included. It installs an assert handler that returns (documented at `netcode.h:362-366`) so it can reach the release-build path, verifies the asserts still fire in debug builds, and verifies an in-range call still succeeds so the guard cannot pass by rejecting everything.

No action needed for valid callers: anyone passing an out-of-range count was already in undefined behaviour.
